(2) The factor (1 + alpha_behav * I/(I_half + I)) is a saturating superspreading enhancement of transmission — a nonlinear, prevalence-dependent Hill-type modification that is not part of the standard SIR/vaccination model. While each individual saturating motif (Hill functions, waning immunity, superspreading) appears somewhere in the literature, the SPECIFIC combined composite form — mass-action incidence multiplied by a Hill superspreading term, minus a product of two independent saturation functions for vaccination throughput and stock limitation, plus waning — is not a recitable textbook equation. No standard reference presents this exact combined form. An LLM could not reproduce this precise structure purely from context; it would require data-driven inference to identify the specific composite saturation terms and their coupling. This exceeds the classical baseline substantially.
